definitions.explanation: A person's former girlfriend. A casual, colloquial term common in conversation and on social media.

examples.japanese: {元|もと}カノ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{偶然|ぐうぜん}→偶然：02674_guuzen⟧⟦{会|あ}った→会う：00482_au⟧。
examples.english: I ran into my ex-girlfriend by chance.

examples.japanese: {元|もと}カノ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧すべて⟦{消|け}した→消す：00528_kesu⟧。
examples.english: I deleted all the photos of my ex-girlfriend.

examples.japanese: {元|もと}カノ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{別|わか}れて→別れる：01113_wakareru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{一年|いちねん}→一年：10994_ichinen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: It has already been a year since I broke up with my ex-girlfriend.

notes:
Colloquial contraction of ⟦{元|もと}→元：03878_moto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧ ('former girlfriend'), with カノ written in katakana. Common in casual speech and text messages.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{元|もと}カレ→元カレ：29938_motokare⟧: ex-boyfriend
- ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧: girlfriend
- {元彼女|もとかのじょ}: the same word written more fully
